threat_event: CAD outage stops dispatch for 14 client agencies at once
threat_source: Ransomware, region failure, or failed change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single CAD instance; client contracts promise notice within 15 minutes
treatment_plan: CAD standby (GR-01); client outage call tree in each center binder
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: CAD vendor support accounts are used to take over the CAD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing local administrator accounts over a persistent VPN

threat_event: Attacker steals client claim files from the revenue cycle file transfer servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servers share the CAD management subnet; files kept 90 days
treatment_plan: Separate account (GR-02); delete files after 14 days

threat_event: AI triage processes client agencies' caller audio without authorization and under-triages some callers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA amendment covers internal divisions only; Spanish-language under-triage
existing_controls: Shadow mode for client calls; advisory only for internal calls at the Florida center
treatment_plan: Exclude client calls from the module until clients consent and the BAA covers them; P10 conditions
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: Possible criminal justice information in the CAD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Premise notes from a sheriff records system
treatment_plan: Act on the CJIS Systems Agency determination (GR-06)

threat_event: Client agency users see another agency's incidents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partitions enforced in the application only
owner: Group dispatch and clinical platforms director

threat_event: BDS misses BAA notice clocks to billing clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 clients have 72-hour terms; register not linked to the SOC case system
treatment_plan: Client notice register in the P08 matrix

threat_event: Card numbers are captured in call recordings and exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual pause of recording; agents hear numbers
treatment_plan: Tone-masked keypad entry; scan and purge recordings (GR-14)

threat_event: A contact center agent misuses card numbers
The coding assistant suggests a higher level of service than the record supports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coders accept suggestions at a high rate
existing_controls: Coder review; monthly audit of 50 claims
treatment_plan: Audit by level of service; acceptance-rate alerts (P10)

threat_event: Revenue cycle platform outage delays client cash flow
treatment_plan: Annual restore exercise with client communication

threat_event: The single clearinghouse is down for weeks and claims stop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One clearinghouse for most ambulance claims

threat_event: Radio console gateways are compromised without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateways not in the SIEM or scanned
existing_controls: Gateways on an isolated center network
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: A communications center is lost to fire or hurricane
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: The denial prediction model deprioritizes appeals that would succeed
Outbound patient balance calls and texts violate consent rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dialer lists not checked against consent records for texts

threat_event: Telecommunicators search CAD history for personal reasons
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: Former clients' data is not returned or destroyed
